key_difference: Both add the same RunFunctionTaskBase destructor that cancels and finishes the promise, but (D) also reroutes ThreadEngine's initial start through a new auto-deleting wrapper runnable to fix the map()/filter() path, which the reviewers deliberately left out of scope and which adds an extra allocation per start, a friend class, and a new cancel-then-threadExit teardown path that can run finish() on an engine that never started.
